blurb: 'What's nine plus ten?' 'Twenty-one.' The most famous incorrect arithmetic in internet history, delivered in 2013 by a kid who never once wavered and never once corrected himself. That unshakeable confidence is the entire reason it survived — a hesitant wrong answer is nothing, a certain one is comedy. It became a founding text of Vine humour and has outlived the app that produced it by years. Use it to respond to any question where the correct answer is not going to be provided. Still funny. Still wrong. Still twenty-one.
origin: From the legendary 2013 Vine — the internet's favourite wrong answer.
